_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Major Milestone Commonality and Configuration Variance Progress Report
summary: The Major Milestone Commonality and Configuration Variance Progress Report provides the Government with Major Milestones and progress against the contractor's Commonality Plan.
use_relationship:
The Major Milestone Commonality and Configuration Variance Progress Report provides the Government with Major Milestones and progress against the contractor's Commonality Plan.
This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Report shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Report shall contain Commonality Goals and Thresholds established at the beginning of the reporting period.

children.title: The Report shall contain historical and demonstrated progress tracked against Commonality Goals and Thresholds by ship work breakdown structure (SWBS) and shall specify the following information:
The name and percentage of Systems and Systems Architectures reused from prior hulls of the same Program/Ship Class and Other Program/Ship Classes.
The name and the percentage of Systems and Systems Architecture components/parts reused from Other Program/Ship Classes.
The name and the percentage of Virtual Shelf Systems and Systems Architectures applied.
The name and the percentage of Virtual Shelf Specifications and Standards Applied in Ship Specification/Design.
The name and the percentage of Virtual Shelf Equipment and Parts applied in Systems and Systems Architectures.
The name and the percentage of Program-Unique Items.
The Report shall specify the number of Virtual Shelf Feedback Reports submitted by the contractor.
The Report shall include all technical and business case analyses for the Feedback reports specified in the Virtual Shelf.
The Report shall specify the estimated cost savings and cost avoidance information resulting from Commonality implementation.
